app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Used to be ok, but don’t bother now
body:
Used to be a decent app but it seems the dev has stopped supporting it. I purchased a lifetime subscription and less than 6 months after that, the app bugs me about subscribing again. Restore purchase only causes an error, and they don’t respond to support email. The cost of the lifetime ”membership” was never worth the price to begin with.

The data can’t be exported, so you’re stuck with this app if you start using it. 

The widget does not work for me either.

DO NOT BOTHER!!!

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: The best time management app so far
body:
The UI is simple and beautiful, the newest update feels like your tasks update physically (haptic feedback and sounds) - almost on par with apples native apps, and it is intuitive.

I’ve been using it to keep track of studies, work, instrument practices, workouts and vocabulary training. It will handle most tasks you throw at it.

The only feature I wish it had would be to set goals for a certain time period. E.g. I would like to study 30h in the next eight days. A possibility to link goals to a category would be helpful in that case, too. For example I could connect the above study example to a category called “Studies” to have a better overview in the stats.

Keep up the amazing work! :)
